note: Starter content. Edit freely; the app validates the schema on load. Demo refs are empty until the parent records or pastes them. Version 0.2.0 adds structured data used by the app: drill modes, layout geometry, baselines, builder templates, the picture quiz, structured advancement rules and the cue-accuracy benchmark. Version 0.3.0 adds cue-engine settings to cueDrills (trigger, reps, timings, catch trials, second cue) and links drills to cue drills. 0.4.0 (part 16 update): competence-based stage names, FocusMetricConfig per drill, scanning modes, S3 as an optional diagnostic, defender archetypes and reaction modes. Sessions that used S3 now use S2 (S3 is an optional diagnostic, D8). 0.5.0: suggested outside demonstration videos (YouTube) for the technique drills, with alternatives and an optional part (start/end) to show; all unverified until a parent checks them. Drills whose prescription gives sets carry structured sets (count and labels) so the app announces each set. 0.5.1: parent-checked demonstrations with the part to show; new candidates for drills whose video did not show the move.

benchmarks.name: Cue-behind decision test
benchmarks.protocol: 10 reps of S2 at the stated cue duration; score correct decisions /10; scans counted on replay when recorded

benchmarks.name: Feint rubric
benchmarks.protocol: 10 reps, 5 L and 5 R exits; 0/1/2 on sell, exit, eyes; totals per side

rubric.2: past the cone in one stride at pace

benchmarks.name: Slalom time and control
benchmarks.protocol: L1 down and back, both patterns; start on tone, finish by tapping the finish target; errors counted; head-up version adds digits /8

benchmarks.name: V-pulls and outside-touch gate
benchmarks.protocol: CB-1: 30 s V-pulls per foot, correct count. CB-2: 10 reps of C2, 5 per foot, pass when the first touch settles in the gate and the second stops it

benchmarks.name: Cue accuracy
benchmarks.protocol: Correct exits or decisions out of 16 in a cue block; scored honestly by the player or the parent

scanning.st1->st2: SB >= 8/10 at 3 s, two consecutive, both feet
scanning.st2->st3: SB >= 8/10 at 2 s twice; parent rubric looked during roll >= 8 reps
scanning.st3->st4: SB >= 8/10 at 1.5 s twice, random timing
scanning.st4->exit: SB >= 8/10 at 1 s and coach transfer observation

feinting.st2->st3: FB >= 44/60 at pace twice; left >= 80% of right
feinting.st3->st4: F5 cue accuracy >= 14/16 and F6 rubric >= 44/60 twice
feinting.st4->exit: coach transfer observation: move linked to pass/shot

dribbling.st2->st3: DB-head-up digits >= 7/8 with errors <= 2 twice; left within 10% of right
dribbling.st3->st4: D3 cue accuracy >= 14/16 and DB-head-up maintained
dribbling.st4->exit: coach transfer observation: head-up dribble linked to pass/shot

control.st2->st3: CB-2 >= 8/10 at pace with left >= 4/5; CB-1 left >= 80% of right
control.st3->st4: C3 cue accuracy >= 14/16 and CB-2 maintained
control.st4->exit: coach transfer observation: first touch away with either foot

questions: Did she read and say the colour on most looks in the roll-and-look drill?
Did she look during the roll before the touch on at least 8 of 10 benchmark reps?
Was the S2 placement drill clean at cue 2 s with the head up?
Was the static body feint clean on both sides?
Did the left-exit total reach at least 70% of the right-exit total?
Was the F2 placement drill clean at pace with the head up?
Were the benchmark control errors 2 or fewer on both patterns?
Was the slalom clean at controlled speed on both feet?
Was the slalom clean at pace with the head up?
Was the mastery set clean on both feet?
Did the left foot pass at least 3 of 5 gate reps?
Was the C2 placement drill clean at pace with the head up?

placementRule.note: Proposal from the parent's three yes/no answers. The parent confirms or overrides; overrides are logged.

builder.note: Slots: A, B, C are the session's 1st, 2nd and 3rd work blocks (C falls back to A). A benchmark slot uses the session's benchmark; without one it repeats A. Light drops benchmark slots (they become rest).

quiz.note: Diagrams of a receiving situation; the correct first touch goes away from the pressure, or back when both sides are blocked.

parentChecks: Both feet were used in the tests
She looked during the roll on at least 8 reps
F6 execution rubric at least 44/60 twice
The gate test was at pace

regression.scanning: Drop one cue duration step and repeat the previous session
regression.feinting: Back to blocked reps (F2/F3) for one session
regression.dribbling: Repeat the previous session at controlled speed
regression.control: Repeat the previous session with the left-foot focus

cueLevelPattern.note: Cue display seconds are read from a block's params ("cue 3 s", "cue 1-1.5 s") or a benchmark's numeric cue level.

components.label: Scan proxy (head turn before the touch)
components.procedure: 20 recorded scanning reps: mark head turned before the touch from the replay, blind to the app; compare.

components.label: First touch direction and gate
components.procedure: 20 receiving reps: mark the gate of the first touch from the replay; compare.

components.label: Feint onset and direction (live)
components.procedure: 20 feints plus 10 control movements: timestamp and direction by hand from the clip; count agreements within 100 ms and false triggers.

components.label: Exit side after the defender

components.label: Controlled exit (ball tracking)
